Subject: Launch Position and Next Step

Hi Avery,

The October 8 production launch was tentative. Security review is now expected to complete no earlier than October 12, and release requires completed approval from Nia.

The team remains positioned to demonstrate the staging environment on October 8 using synthetic data. This gives us a meaningful opportunity to review the experience while the security process concludes.

We remain confident in the team’s execution and will follow the review outcome closely. Because the review may identify remediation needs, we do not yet have an authorized production launch date.

Please confirm whether you would like us to proceed with the October 8 staging demo.

Best,  
Jordan
